page.overview:
Who is Barapasaurus?

is an extinct genus of basal sauropod dinosaur that lived in India during the Early Jurassic period. Barapasaurus was one of the earliest of the giant, long-necked plant-eaters. It is very well known because many different individuals have been found. The only trouble is, no head has been discovered, so its complete look remains a mystery.

The bone bed where Barapasaurus was discovered contained the remains of as many as 300 sauropod specimens. Consequently, the composite skeleton constructed from these fossils may have some proportional errors.

Barapasaurus was featured in the Jurassic Park Institute now available to browse on Dinopedia.
